name: Dermaclick SA Serum
description:
Dermaclick SA Serum combines 10% Niacinamide, Zinc PCA, Hyaluronic Acid, Rice Water and Vitamin E in a multi-benefit skincare formula designed to address several everyday skin concerns.
10% Niacinamide helps support the skin barrier and is commonly used in skincare aimed at excess oil and uneven-looking tone. Zinc PCA complements the formula with an oil-control-focused approach, while Hyaluronic Acid supports skin hydration.
Enriched with Rice Water and Vitamin E, the formula also provides a skin-conditioning and hydration-focused element, making it more than a basic single-ingredient niacinamide serum.
shortDescription: A multi-benefit serum with 10% Niacinamide, Zinc PCA, Hyaluronic Acid, Rice Water and Vitamin E for oil-control, hydration and skin-barrier support.
suitableFor: Best suited for oily/combination skin and oil-control-focused skincare routines.

name: Dermaclick Vitamin C Serum
shortDescription: 10% Vitamin C serum with antioxidant and brightening-focused benefits, designed to improve uneven-looking tone and support smoother, more refined-looking skin.
description:
Dermaclick Vitamin C Serum is formulated with 10% Vitamin C and designed to support a brighter, more even-looking complexion.
Vitamin C provides antioxidant support against environmental oxidative stress while helping address the appearance of uneven skin tone and pigmentation concerns. The formula is also positioned to help reduce the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles, smooth the appearance of crow's feet, and refine the appearance of pores.
A focused addition to your daily skincare routine, this serum is suitable for all skin types.

Brightening Support — Helps promote a brighter, more even-looking complexion.
Uneven Tone — Designed to improve the appearance of uneven skin tone.
Fine Lines & Wrinkles — Helps reduce their appearance.
Crow's Feet — Helps smooth their appearance.
Pore Refining — Helps refine the appearance of pores.
All Skin Types — Suitable for all skin types.
